Simulated dataset on the Italian peninsula

Source: R/data_definitions.R
italy_sim.Rd

Simulated dataset over Italy for a continuous outcome.

Usage

data(italy_sim)

Format

An sf object with 2000 rows (10 repeated observations for each of the 200 geo-referenced locations) and 6 variables:

y

simulated continuous outcome.

region

the name of the region within which a given observation falls.

province

the name of the province within which a given observation falls.

pop_dens

the population density at the location of the observation.

ID_loc

an ID identifying the location to which the observation belong.

geometry

Simple feature geometry (POINT) giving the sampling coordinates in metres

Details

The coordinate reference system is WGS 84 / UTM zone 33N (EPSG:32633), which distorts distances by less than 0.5% over the data. The outcome was simulated in UTM zone 34N (EPSG:32634), so its spatial correlation is isotropic in those coordinates, and its range in the coordinates of the data varies by up to about 1.4% over Italy.
